summary: Implemented a strict published-only public project projection with optional approved developer identity, deterministic published/active linked-property filtering, safe empty-state behavior, and contract/test coverage.

verification.notes: 8 focused project CRUD, workflow, route, and public projection tests passed.
All 263 tests passed with enforced coverage thresholds.
Existing project CRUD/review inventory remains synchronized; no speculative public route added.
Agent Pack audit has zero errors.
All changed JSON files parsed successfully.

scopeNotes: No public project route was invented because the canonical endpoint blueprint has no such route and the property runtime is the next dependency; the reusable projection contract is ready for the later public properties surface.
Linked properties are accepted only as published and active records and safely return an empty array when the property adapter has no data.
Live MongoDB integration was not run because isolated replica-set prerequisites and TEST_MONGODB_URI were unavailable.
knownGaps: Node v22.18.0 is available while the repository declares Node >=24 <25.
Production organization/property data is not seeded; the projection uses explicit optional developer data and deterministic empty linked-property state.
